trigger: Certified SAT runs still reject algebraic roots after solving because trace compatibility is necessary but not sufficient for rational lifting.
mechanism: Precompute the exact valid k-bit coordinate assignments for each fixed affine factor space and add one blocking clause for every invalid assignment in each summand block. This enforces factor-base membership before Semaev solving.
shared_targets: Reuse the first targets from sat-rank-amendment.json and its deterministic target rule; append targets from the same RNG stream at n=17.
filter_cost: Charge factor-base enumeration, curve lifting, clauses, encoding time and solver time. The filter uses no target and no relation outcome.
verification: Every returned model must satisfy the original ANF and every accepted witness must lift to target-subgroup points summing to the target. Filtered runs must have zero rejected factor-coordinate projections.
success: A higher certified relation count or lower measured time on shared targets earns larger replication; it is not by itself a breakthrough claim.
falsifier: No improvement under paired targets, or clause overhead cancels removed invalid projections.
